target: clean_core_median_cents = median(_core_slice(clean cents contour)), recomputed and checked against stored core_median_cents

feature_definitions.centering: centered = cents - median(_core_slice(cents)); the core median is the target N, used only for this subtraction
feature_definitions.pitch_class: circular: sin/cos(2*pi*(target_midi mod 12)/12); chosen over one-hot to keep the feature count small and the representation continuous
feature_definitions.regions: by frame index: k = max(1, floor(0.2*n)); onset = first k, release = last k, middle = frames k..n-k (whole contour if empty)
feature_definitions.halves: first floor(n/2) frames vs the rest
feature_definitions.slope: OLS slope of centered on linspace(0,1,n) (cents per note); 0 if n < 2
feature_definitions.d1/d2: adjacent first/second differences of centered; n >= 3 for every note so both exist
feature_definitions.direction_changes: sign changes between successive nonzero d1; rate = changes / max(1, nonzero_d1 - 1)
feature_definitions.zero_crossings: sign changes of nonzero centered values around 0; rate = crossings / (n - 1)
feature_definitions.turning_points: sign changes of successive nonzero differences of the linearly detrended contour; rate = / max(1, n - 2)
feature_definitions.autocorrelation: n >= 20: largest positive normalized autocorrelation of the detrended contour over lags 2..n//2 and its lag in frames; otherwise 0, 0, acf_eligible = 0
feature_definitions.conf_vs_abs_d1_corr: Pearson correlation of confidence[1:] with |d1| when n >= 5 and both vary; otherwise 0
feature_definitions.context: neighbours are the previous/next note in the song's canonical v2 notes.npz; interval in semitones of target MIDI; gaps = start - previous end, next start - end; missing neighbour -> 0 with has_previous/has_next = 0; no neighbour cents ever used

cv_design.method: GroupKFold(5) by song on train clean notes
cv_design.selection: lowest mean CV MAE over every (feature set, model, hyperparameter)

structural_identity.note: N_hat comes from each example's own features; equality across siblings is measured, not imposed

comparison_to_ridge.core_median_baseline_equivalent: with N_hat = 0 this estimator is exactly the core-median baseline (MAE 17.4255)

feature_importance.method: grouped-fold permutation on train (validation unused), 3 repeats; MAE increase when permuted; groups permuted jointly

integrity.feature_inputs: own cents contour (centered), own confidence, own duration, own target MIDI, neighbours' target MIDI + timing
